assertions.statement: The docforge-project-skill npm package explicitly installs a discoverable docforge-project Skill without npm lifecycle side effects.
A UTF-8 ordinary Markdown document becomes a new docforge.project.v1 project using general, und, document.md, and docforge-standard defaults.
Headings, paragraphs, emphasis, code, links, lists, block quotes, tables, math, footnotes, citations, and local images retain supported semantic content after import.
Local images are copied to deterministic confined asset paths and missing IDs are normalized to stable valid fig IDs.
Only known explicit neutral metadata is written to docforge.yaml, while unknown metadata is reported and no academic information is fabricated.
Existing destinations, traversal, symlink escape, absolute or device paths, remote downloads, and unsafe package entries are rejected without partial writes.
Unsupported syntax, missing local resources, citations without bibliography, invalid encoding, and missing DocForge runtime produce structured actionable diagnostics.
Every successful imported fixture passes docforge inspect and validate offline, and the comprehensive fixture also passes docforge build.

Yao Governed gates pass for Skill IR, compiled targets, trigger and output eval, trust, conformance, permissions, package verification, install simulation, upgrade, Atlas, registry, Review Studio, promotion, and cross-platform paths.
Skill and package descriptions consistently promise Markdown-to-DocForge-project conversion and contain no direct DOCX or thesis-only implementation path.
